title: Aspen Dental Opens Three New Practices in Three States
html:
Established practice owners Dr. Hattie Willard, Dr. Jebediah Christy, and Dr. Shekhar Gupta add offices as the Aspen Dental network grows.

Aspen Dental® today announced the opening of offices in Pueblo, CO; Moncks Corner, SC; and Hanover, MD. The practices are independently owned and operated by Hattie Willard, DDS, in Pueblo; Jebediah Christy, DMD, in Moncks Corner; and Shekhar Gupta, DDS, in Hanover. Each office offers a full range of dental services under one roof, including preventive care, emergency dentistry, dentures, implants, crowns, bridges, oral surgery, and Motto™ Clear Aligners, along with walk-in availability, same-day appointments for dental emergencies, and clear, upfront cost estimates.

The three openings are the latest example of a network built around developing doctors and providing a path to practice ownership. Aspen Dental’s Practice Ownership Program, launched in 2004, gives doctors a structured progression from associate to practice owner. In the decade from 2014 to 2024, the number of practice owners more than tripled, from 85 to 277. Owners also mentor newer doctors on their career progression, and some go on to become multi-practice owners, as Dr. Willard, Dr. Christy, and Dr. Gupta have, with The Aspen Group (TAG) providing nonclinical support, such as technology and training.

“Creating more access to care is only possible when more doctors are willing and prepared to open practices in new communities. Aspen Dental’s model is built to develop those doctors and give them a clear path to ownership, so each new practice has an experienced, invested dentist at its center. That is how three openings in three states happen on the same day,” said Dr. Arwinder Judge, chief clinical officer at Aspen Dental.

Dr. Christy has been part of the Aspen Dental network since 2007 and opened a practice in Travelers Rest, SC, in July. His new Moncks Corner office opens in a county that added about 45,000 residents between April 2020 and July 2025, an increase of 19.5% compared with 3.1% nationwide, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. As the county grows, the practice gives its new and longtime residents a convenient place to establish dental care.

Pueblo County is home to 11,611 veterans, according to the Census Bureau. Dr. Willard, a former U.S. Air Force captain who treated active-duty service members and their families at Peterson Space Force Base, joined the network in 2023 and adds Pueblo to her practices. About 58% of Pueblo County adults visited a dentist or dental clinic in the past year, compared with about 63% nationally, according to 2022 estimates from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. With walk-ins and same-day emergency appointments, the new office makes it easier for residents to get in and be seen when they need care.

Dr. Gupta, a graduate of New York University College of Dentistry, has been in the network since 2005 and adds Hanover to his practices. For patients who need routine care, such as exams and cleanings, or who are exploring ways to restore their smiles, such as crowns, dentures, or implants, the office offers convenient hours and an easy-to-reach location.

Patients at all three offices can use the Aspen Dental app, which launched in October, to book appointments, complete pre-visit steps, view their treatment plans, and track their progress toward completing care.

All three offices accept many major dental insurance plans and offer flexible financing options.

  • Moncks Corner, SC: 609 N. Highway 52, Moncks Corner, SC 29461. Phone: (854) 206-8099. Hours: Monday–Thursday, 7 AM–5 PM; Friday, 7 AM–noon; Saturday, 8 AM–1 PM

To schedule an appointment, patients can visit aspendental.com or book through the Aspen Dental app. Walk-ins are welcome.

About Aspen Dental

Aspen Dental, part of The Aspen Group (TAG), is committed to breaking down barriers to oral healthcare and helping patients put themselves first, starting with a healthy mouth. With nearly 1,100 Aspen Dental-branded offices across the United States, Aspen Dental practices offer comprehensive care and are supported by dedicated teams focused on making dental care more accessible and affordable. Through initiatives such as the Healthy Mouth Movement and Day of Service, Aspen Dental and its network continue to expand access to care for those who need it most. Aspen Dental-branded practices are independently owned and operated by licensed dentists. Aspen Dental Management, Inc. provides business support services to these practices.

For more information, visit aspendental.com, and follow Aspen Dental on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
